candidates.change_summary: Remove the call to withdraw, making withdrawAll a no-op that transfers nothing.
Withdraw a fixed amount of 0 instead of the contract's full balance.
Drop the onlyOwner guard so any caller can drain the contract balance.
Invert the ownership check in the onlyOwner modifier so it passes for anyone except the owner.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw() sends nothing to the caller.
Replace the transferred amount with a fixed 1 wei regardless of _value.
Remove the require check so any caller, not just the owner, can execute withdraw and withdrawAll.
Remove the require that checks the call result, so failed sends no longer revert.
Invert the success check so sendMoney reverts when the call succeeds and proceeds when it fails.
Send the value to the contract owner instead of the specified _target address.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney so any caller can execute it.
Invert the ownership check in the modifier so only non-owners pass.
Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll transfers nothing.
Withdraw one less wei than the full balance, leaving 1 wei in the contract.
Insert a transfer of 1 wei to the caller before withdrawing the remaining balance.
Remove the require check so the onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts access, allowing any caller to execute withdrawAll.
